description: Find support tickets by status, requester email, or a keyword in subject/body. Use this when someone asks to list, find, or search tickets. Default status is open — an empty list means no match for those filters, not that the server is empty; broaden to status=all or drop requester_email. Do not retry the same filters. To fetch one known id use get_ticket or read ticket://TCK-1001. Do not invent query_tickets or a generic HTTP request tool.

limit.description: Max rows to return. Default 10, max 25.

query.description: Optional keyword matched against subject and body, e.g. hostname or mcp.json.

requester_email.description: Optional exact customer email, e.g. ada@example.com. Combine with status=all if you are unsure the ticket is still open.

status.description: Lifecycle filter. Default open. Use all if a search comes back empty.

name: search_tickets
